style: Flat explanatory illustration, infographic style, restrained color palette, Chinese annotations, PPT/PDF presentation illustration style. Clean geometric shapes, solid color blocks, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D effects. Color scheme: China = deep red (#C41E3A), USA = blue (#2E5B8A), Gulf = gold (#C9A84C), Pakistan = dark green (#014D16), background = light gray (#F5F5F5), text = dark gray (#333333). Simple flat icons, single-weight arrows, clean composition suitable for mobile reading.

Bottom: two arrows diverging downward, one solid green labeled as survival achieved, one dashed gray labeled as transformation not achieved. Light background, minimal text, geometric shapes only, no human figures, no flags, no maps.

images.prompt: Flat infographic illustration, symmetric H-shape layout. Left column: outward arrow with three small colored dots and short labels. Right column: inward arrow with two gray dots and short labels. Center: a simple horizontal bar connecting both columns. Clean corporate style, light background, minimal text, geometric shapes only.

negative_prompts: 阴谋论视觉：暗色背景、神秘剪影、阴影暗示
写实人物肖像：鲁比奥、阿西姆·穆尼尔等任何真实人物面孔
过度装饰：渐变、3D效果、阴影、纹理背景
写实地图：精确国界线、地形起伏、卫星图
情绪化表述：崩溃边缘、被救助的弱者、绝望等
扁平标签词汇：巴铁、战略支轴、缓冲国、失败国家
未核实数据图表：超出文章已放行事实的数字
论文腔图表：密密麻麻的数据表格、引用标注
短视频腔装饰：表情包、emoji、夸张箭头
AI生成痕迹：签名、水印、低分辨率图标
consistency_rules: 所有6张图使用统一配色方案：深红=#C41E3A（中国）、蓝=#2E5B8A（美国）、金=#C9A84C（海湾）、深绿=#014D16（巴基斯坦国土/主体）、浅灰=#F5F5F5（背景）、深灰=#333333（文字）
所有6张图使用统一扁平风格：纯色块、简单几何形状、无渐变、无阴影、无3D效果
所有6张图中文标注为主，关键术语全中文覆盖
所有6张图保持麦肯锡/经济学教材PPT的克制专业感
图片宽高比统一为1536x1024（横版3:2），适配信息图横版阅读场景
封面图与图1-5在视觉上形成系列感：共用配色体系和风格语言
